svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: One host runs four tc eBPF hooks that share pinned maps: the VM hook on each VM interface, the WireGuard hook on wg0, the uplink hook on the private uplink to other hosts, and the public hook on the public interface to the provider router.
